title: Screen Readers
definition: Software programs that allow blind or visually impaired users to read the text that is displayed on the computer screen via a speech synthesizer or braille display. Popular ones include VoiceOver (Mac), NVDA, and JAWS.
simpleExplanation: A robot voice that reads the website out loud to the user. It relies entirely on your Semantic HTML to understand what is important.
